C1481.title: Amitabh Bachchan Wins Metaverse Identity Theft Lawsuit
C1481.summary: Indian actor Amitabh Bachchan prevailed in a Delhi High Court case concerning identity theft in the metaverse. The suit involved unauthorized use of his name, voice, and likeness in virtual environments. The court's ruling safeguards personal identity rights in digital worlds, blocking unlawful misappropriation and fabrication of virtual personas.
